issue: Missing weeks (2019 W16; 2020 W11-18 COVID lockdown; 2020 W41-52; 2021 W1-2, W21-24, W34)
core_handling: Filled from DCS weekly retail where available (KI-19); remaining short gaps log-linearly interpolated

issue: Week 53 present in 2024 wholesale but not retail; HARTI weeks are not ISO weeks
core_handling: Week 53 averaged into week 52; calendar uses 7-day blocks from 1 Jan (week 52 spans 8-9 days)

issue: Red pumpkin 2024/25 Maha production (9,608.4 t) identical to the capsicum value; implies 2.3 t/ha vs ~11 t/ha normally
core_handling: Core uses extent x 11.0 t/ha; raw value retained

issue: Bandakka 2025 Yala equals Ash plantain 2025 Maha (32,681.1) in the DCS workbook - copy errors in 2025 provisional data
Values revised between AgStat editions (e.g. 2022 tomato annual extent 6,008 ha in AgStat 2023 vs 5,893 ha in AgStat 2024)
District name variants and text-extraction splits: Moneragala, Nuwaraeliya, N eliya, Mullathivu, Kurunagala, "Pol onnaruwa IP", "Hasal aka IP", "Monaragal a IP"
core_handling: Canonicalised to 25 standard district names; inter-province rows merged into their district

issue: Some bulletins are image-only; several reports are partial-season progress, not finals
core_handling: District shares taken from the latest report per season (6 seasons); other seasons use the mean same-season share with year-to-year variation

issue: DOA Crop Forecast winged bean extent (~650-740 ha) far below DCS 3-season averages (~960-1,130 ha) - different methodologies
Yield, cost and profit published per acre
core_handling: Unit costs (Rs/kg) carried; per-hectare values derived with 1 ha = 2.471 ac

issue: 2020/21 Maha special issue (COVID) omitted vegetables except green chilli; cucumber and winged bean never surveyed
core_handling: Tomato and pumpkin interpolated in real terms; cucumber and winged bean modelled (see data sources and methods)
Extended to 2025-12-31 from analog years with day-level perturbation

issue: No winged bean price series in HARTI or DCS weekly files
core_handling: Weekly series modelled from AgStat annual farm-gate prices and the observed low-country seasonal profile

issue: No public market-arrivals series for any economic centre
core_handling: Arrivals modelled from production, planting progress, crop calendar, loss rates, DEC share and district routing

issue: Only selected official monthly CCPI points available in project files
core_handling: Monthly CCPI log-interpolated between anchors; replace with the official DCS series

issue: WFP commodity "Chili" is dried chilli (r=0.99 with DCS Dried Chillies No 1; r=0.20 with HARTI green chilli)
District rows limited to the crop-district footprint (29 pairs); national totals also include minor cultivation in other districts
core_handling: District values are not rescaled to national totals; footprint districts carry their DOA-reported share

issue: WFP market coverage is sparse (about 15-24 of 67 months per market-crop) and mostly retail; three DECs have no WFP market (proxies: Colombo City, Gampaha, Puttalam)
core_handling: Used for relative price levels between markets, shrunk towards market means

issue: DCS weekly retail runs 5-11% above HARTI Colombo retail (r=0.96-0.99); DCS series ends 2024-09
core_handling: Level-adjusted by crop-specific median ratio before filling HARTI gaps
